title: Rename fetchUserData to loadUser across the codebase
prompt: In this TypeScript project, rename the exported function `fetchUserData` (defined in src/api/users.ts) to `loadUser`. Update every import, re-export, call site and test so the project keeps working. After the change the identifier `fetchUserData` must not appear anywhere under src/ or test/ (no compatibility alias). Do not rename other functions with similar names, such as `fetchUserDataset` in src/analytics/dataset.ts, and do not change behavior. Run the tests with `node --test test/*.test.ts`.
